description: This PHP class, EmployeeLanguage, extends a FilterField to facilitate filtering employee data based on their language skills within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with the database via QueryBuilderWrapper, utilizes a LanguageService to fetch language details, and implements ValueXNormalizable to provide normalized representation of language data.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguage
classes.description: A PHP class that extends FilterField to filter employee records based on their language skills. Implements methods for constructing query conditions and converting language data into an array format for further use.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a WHERE condition to the query builder to filter by employee language if the operator is EQUAL and the value is not null.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in the query, in this case ['language'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Uses LanguageService to retrieve a Language entity by ID and returns its id and name as an associative array if found.
